notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection covers title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but the UI neither opens the existing bookmark for editing nor prevents an explicitly confirmed duplicate.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no autocomplete for existing tags.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal characters rather than exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive is unavailable, so it cannot be distinguished from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
